description: A PHP class implementing compilation logic for the Smarty templating engine, specifically handling calls to user-defined template functions via {function} tags. It processes attributes, manages caching considerations, and generates PHP code for template rendering.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Call
classes.description: Handles compilation of {function} calls within Smarty templates, generating PHP code to invoke user-defined template functions with proper attribute handling and caching considerations.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a Smarty {function} tag call into executable PHP code, managing attributes, caching flags, and output assignment if specified.
